description: Single source of truth for redirects and response headers on pequeverso.com. scripts/gen-htaccess.mjs renders it to out/.htaccess (static target); next.config.mjs attaches it as redirects()/headers() (standalone target). The old-domain cutover block lives in docs/migration/old-domain.htaccess and is not part of this file. The ?offer=downsell alias is handled client-side by the offer-mode script (no redirect, to avoid query-merge loops).

hsts.note: Raise maxAge to 31536000 only after apex and www have served valid HTTPS for a week (docs/migration.md).

redirects.description: URLs indexed from the previous owner of pequeverso.com (Montessori shop). Return 410 Gone.

headers.Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://checkout.hotmart.com https://*.hotmart.com https://connect.facebook.net https://cloud.umami.is; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.hotmart.com https://www.facebook.com https://connect.facebook.net https://cloud.umami.is https://api-gateway.umami.dev; frame-src https://*.hotmart.com https://www.facebook.com; media-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self' https://*.hotmart.com; frame-ancestors 'self'
